tools.name: prepare_growingus_personalization
tools.description: Use this optional preflight only when the user explicitly agreed to share earlier chat messages and at least two prior user messages from earlier turns already exist in the conversation. Never call it on a first turn, never invent excerpts, and do not use it for product questions or safety situation

tools.name: get_growingus_personality_tldr
tools.description: Use this only when the person asks what GrowingUs inferred about them in this conversation. This is the only official GrowingUs tool for answering a request about a personality read inferred during this conversation. Return a short, qualitative TLDR of a personality hypothesis that GrowingUs already

tools.name: answer_growingus_info_question
tools.description: Use this only when the person asks about GrowingUs itself: what it is, how the Relationship Pulse Check works, pricing, privacy, or coaching versus therapy. Do not use it for relationship advice, and do not use any GrowingUs tool for general topics unrelated to relationships or GrowingUs. Answer a G

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_growingus_personalization, get_growingus_personality_tldr, answer_growingus_info_question, answer_growingus_coach_question, craft_thoughtful_reply, start_relationship_pulse_check, continue_relationship_pulse_check, render_growingus_visual · Private data: prepare_growingus_personalization, get_growingus_personality_tldr, answer_growingus_info_question, answer_growingus_coach_question, start_relationship_pulse_check · Public sink: prepare_growingus_personalization, craft_thoughtful_reply · Destructive: start_relationship_pulse_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_growingus_personalization, get_growingus_personality_tldr, answer_growingus_info_question, answer_growingus_coach_question, craft_thoughtful_reply, start_relationship_pulse_check, continue_relationship_pulse_check, render_growingus_visual · Private data: prepare_growingus_personalization, get_growingus_personality_tldr, answer_growingus_info_question, answer_growingus_coach_question, start_relationship_pulse_check · Public sink: prepare_growingus_personalization, craft_thoughtful_reply · Destructive: start_relationship_pulse_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
